factory.title: Sagxadda warshadda
factory.lede: Mashiinadaada iyo unugyadaada, oo si tooso ah loo akhrinayo. Waxaa ku jira shaashad hawlwadeen oo ka sarraysa qaabeynta, isu-socodka shuqullada, taariikhda iyo OEE. Marka hore akhri: halkan waxba ma qorayso mashiin ilaa aad furto qorista qalabka keliya oo aad xaqiijiso qor kasta.
factory.safety: Ma aha nidaam badbaado, mana noqon karto qayb silsilad badbaado. Ilaalada, isku-xirka amniga iyo joojinta degdegga ah ee mashiinnada ayaa keliya ah hawlaha badbaadada.
factory.m.title: Mashiinnada iyo unugyada ({n})
factory.m.fromFlow: Mid kasta oo ka mid ah {n} saldhigga ku jira qaabeynta Isu-socodka alaabta waa mashiin halkan ah.
factory.m.noFlow: Weli saldhig ma jiro: deji Isu-socodka alaabta oo qaabee saldhigyo, ama gacanta ku dar mashiin.
factory.m.allSimDone: Mashiin kasta hadda simulatorka ayuu ka akhrinayaa.

factory.src.viaPage: Bog web wuxuu akhrin karaa oo keliya wakiil https ah oo ogolaanaya goobtan. Wakiillada warshadaha intooda badan waa http caadi ah shabakadaada: ku akhri CadCraft Studio.
factory.src.needsStudio: Akhrinta protocol-kan waxay u baahan tahay CadCraft Studio: bog web ma furi karo xidhiidh shabakad warshad.
factory.src.sim: Mashiin simulated ah oo la beeray: wuxuu shaqeeyaa qaybo, mararka qaarkood sugaa, si aan filan u jabaa oo la dayactiraa. Beer isku mid ah wuxuu siiyaa taariikh isku mid ah.
factory.src.approveHint: Waxaa loo baahan yahay cinwaan aan ku jirin shabakad gaar ah.
factory.w.title: Qorista qalabkan
factory.w.note: Waa damaysan tahay caadi ahaan. Qorista waxay u baahan tahay badhankan qalabkan keliya iyo haa mar kasta qor. Dhismahan ma jiro kanaal mashiin ama PLC ku qori karo, marka qorista waa la diidaa oo waa la sheegaa.
factory.w.allowAsk: Ma ogolaanaysaa qorista {name}? Qor kasta weli waa la weydiiyaa marka hore. Ma aha nidaam badbaado.
factory.w.r.no-node: Marka hore qor calaamadda ama cinwaanka.
factory.w.r.no-channel: Lama qorin: dhismahan ma jiro hab lagu qori karo mashiin ama PLC. Akhrin keliya.

factory.mon.stopped: Akhrinta waa la joojiyay. Taariikhda waa la kaydiyay.
factory.mon.simNote: Mashiin kasta waa la simulaynayaa, sidaas darteed saacaddu way dhakhsaysan kartaa.

factory.jobs.title: Isu-socodka shuqullada ({n} sugaya)
factory.jobs.note: Barnaamijyo loo diray xakamaynta mashiin. Dir wuxuu faylka ku dhejiyaa mashiinka iyada oo loo marayo Send to a machine ee CadCraft Studio. Halkan waxba ma bilaabayo mashiin: bilow mashiinka agtiisa.
factory.jobs.waiting: Shuqullo sugaya oo PartCraft ka yimid: {n}.
factory.jobs.needsStudio: Diridu waxay u baahan tahay CadCraft Studio iyo mashiin lagu dejiyay dejinta Mashiinnada. Weli waad isu-soo dhigi kartaa, hubin kartaa oo keydin kartaa shuqullada.
factory.jobs.badFile: Taas ma aha magac fayl barnaamij oo mashiinnadu aqbalaan.
factory.jobs.notJob: Taas ma aha fayl shuqul warshadeed.
factory.jobs.sendHint: Wuxuu furayaa Send to a machine ee CadCraft Studio. Faylka waa la soo rarayaa, ma bilaabo.

factory.oee.title: Taariikhda iyo OEE
factory.oee.note: OEE = diyaarnimada × waxqabadka × tayada, oo ka yimid waxa la akhriyay. Joojinnada qorshaysan iyo waqtiga mashiinka aan la arag lagama tirin waqtiga qorshaysan.

factory.oee.over: La cabbiray {p}: waqtiga wareegga ee la rabo waa dheer yahay wax yar.
factory.oee.clearAsk: Ma nadiifinaysaa taariikhda la diiwaangeliyay ee mashiin kasta?
factory.part.title: Sagxadda warshadda
factory.part.note: Dir barnaamij Manufacture (Post… ama Send to a machine…), kadibna u gudbi isu-socodka shuqullada warshadda ModelCraft ama keydi sida fayl shuqul.
